name: nft-ct-ct-new-drop-policy-drop-with-accept
description: ct-new-drop with a policy-drop chain with the peer already accepted
setup: nft add chain inet f out "{ type filter hook output priority 0; policy drop; }"
nft add rule inet f out ip daddr 10.5.5.2 accept

action.spec: nft add rule inet f out ct state new drop
